'''R6-D3''' was an [[R6 astromech droid]] that served as a [[pilot]] for a [[speeder]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Mandalorian 3" /> The [[Astromech droid|droid]] drove a [[repulsorlift]] cart to move cargo and equipment.<ref name="Toy" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> after the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] rescued the [[Force-sensitive]] [[youngling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] from [[The Client]], he alerted the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] to his location. When the leader of the guild, [[Greef Karga]] confronted him, Karga suggested Grogu be placed on the speeder the [[droid]] piloted. As he made his way to the speeder, Djarin decided to use it to escape, threatening to shoot the droid if<ref name="Mandalorian 3" /> it<ref name="Mandalorian 3 AD" /> refused. As the droid drove away, Karga precisely shot the droid with his [[blaster]], destroying the pilot and stopping the getaway [[repulsorcraft]].<ref name="Mandalorian 3" /> R6-D3 had a [[Color|white]] body and gold plating.<ref name="Toy" />

==Behind the scenes==
R6-D3 first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' episode "[[Chapter 3: The Sin]]."<ref name="Mandalorian 3" /> It was created in the form of an action figure released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] in [[2021]] as part of a set with three other droids from ''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' as part of the [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] toy line, which first identified R6-D3's name.<ref name="Toy" />
